content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WCD Odisha to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment is 20th August 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required is passing the 10th class or an equivalent examination. Additionally, candidates must possess knowledge of the Odia language.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Anganwadi Worker position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Anganwadi Worker post is between 18 years and 35 years as of 1st January 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Anganwadi Worker post will receive an honorarium of Rs. 10,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of WCD Odisha. The application link and detailed instructions are provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Anganwadi Worker role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves Document Verification followed by the preparation of a Merit List based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination and any additional points.

faq.question: Q8. What documents do I need to upload during the application process?
faq.answer: Candidates are generally required to upload their photograph, signature, and relevant educational certificates in the prescribed format. Specific details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Odisha apply for this post?
faq.answer: No, candidates must be a permanent resident of the Anganwadi center's jurisdiction village/locality to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Anganwadi Worker position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Anganwadi Worker position is on a contract basis.
